texts.title: QRPh and WebPay
texts.tagline: Accept every payment in the Philippines
texts.description: Online. In-store. In crypto. One integration.
texts.who: Online merchants, in-store merchants, and aggregators accepting payments from any Philippine wallet, bank, or crypto holder.

what:
Hosted and API-based checkout
for web and app.
In-store QR codes, plus credit card acceptance through POS terminals.
Checkout in PHP, USDT, USDC, BTC, ETH. One-tap repeat buying via WebPay.
